name: Kazahaya
source:
An attendent who has served Chihiro since she was a child.
He looked after her in the modern world as a high school teacher.
He's like a big brother to Chihiro. A refreshing and bright youth.

Technically the first Seiryu of Heaven of the series. 
His particular trait is "Compassion"
